title: in-toto Attestation Framework v1 building blocks
description: JSON Schema transcription of the in-toto Attestation Framework v1 (https://github.com/in-toto/attestation/tree/main/spec/v1). in-toto defines these types normatively as protobuf plus prose and ships no JSON Schema, so this file mirrors the spec so that leanvfy predicates can reuse the standard types. Only $defs are provided; reference them as in-toto-v1.json#/$defs/<Name>.
$comment: This file may carry an absolute $id because it only contains fragment-only ($ref: '#/...') references. Schemas that $ref this file by relative path must NOT declare an absolute $id, otherwise validators resolve the relative reference against that $id and try to fetch it over the network.

TypeURI.description: Absolute URI identifying a type (spec/v1/field_types.md#TypeURI). SHOULD resolve to a human-readable description, MAY be unresolvable.

ResourceURI.description: RFC 3986 URI identifying or locating a resource (spec/v1/field_types.md#ResourceURI). The pattern only enforces a scheme and no whitespace; `format` is advisory because validators check it only when an optional RFC 3986 package is installed.

DigestSet.description: Set of one or more cryptographic digests of a single artifact, keyed by algorithm (spec/v1/digest_set.md). Values for hash algorithms are lowercase hex. Additional algorithms MAY be used; consumers only need to recognise one entry.

ResourceDescriptor.description: Identifies or describes a software artifact (spec/v1/resource_descriptor.md). All fields are optional, but at least one of uri, digest or content MUST be set.
ResourceDescriptor.$comment: Deliberately closed (additionalProperties: false): in-toto's designated extension point is the free-form `annotations` object, not new top-level keys. Extend by constraining `annotations`, never by adding siblings.

name.description: Machine-readable identifier for distinguishing between descriptors; interpretation is predicate-specific.

uri.description: Identifies or locates the resource, e.g. where it was fetched from.

content.description: Inline content of the resource, base64-encoded.

downloadLocation.description: Location the resource can be downloaded from, when different from uri.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the resource.

annotations.description: Free-form metadata about the resource; the only sanctioned extension point of a ResourceDescriptor.

Statement.description: in-toto Statement v1 envelope (spec/v1/statement.md): binds a predicate to the subject artifacts it is about. GitHub's actions/attest produces this around the leanvfy predicate.

items.description: Every subject MUST carry a digest so consumers can bind the statement to an artifact they hold.

predicate.description: Predicate-specific payload; its schema is selected by predicateType. Unset is treated as empty.

gitOid.description: Git object id: SHA-1 (40 hex) or SHA-256 (64 hex) repository format.
